questions.question: In a vision of a woman riding a scarlet beast, which city's name was written on her forehead?
In a vision, a scarlet beast carrying a woman was covered with names that honor God. True or false?
In a vision, ten kings make war on the Lamb. Why does the angel say the Lamb will triumph?

answers.text: He rules over all lords and kings
The ten kings turn on each other
The angels fight the battle for Him

questions.question: In a vision of a woman on a scarlet beast, what did the angel say the woman is?

answers.text: A great city that rules the kings of the earth
A queen from a land far beyond the sea
An idol the kings of the earth set up
